source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting failed advertised specifications in a consumer product performance report

1. Start with the test records.
2.
completion:
Identify all conditions under which the failed advertised specification applies (e.g., products, batches, tests).
3. Provide a descriptive name for the specification (e.g., water flow rate).
4. Report test results, if any claims are listed as being based on actual test data.
5. Indicate the test method used.
6. Document any conditions of the test method (e.g., how the testing was conducted, pre-processing of samples, where/how test sample was obtained).
7. Report the data and analytical result for the advertised specification.
8. Make a determination of whether the specification failed.
9. Report the test results from the recalled batch or date code (optional)
10. Report your conclusions.

# For failed advertised specification, include supporting test data

1. Raw or final data/tabular results of the tests.
2. Laboratory report
